title: 512. Sequence Reconstruction

examples.explanation: Both 1,2,3 and 1,3,2 fit, so the order is not unique.
The three pairs force 1 before 2 before 3.
Chained pairs fix the full order.

hints: Turn each adjacent pair in every sequence into a directed edge.
A breadth-first topological walk must always have exactly one ready node; two choices means not unique.
The walk must emit exactly nums in order, and every value of nums must appear in sequences.
